title: ModelResponse
description: Contract for structured model outputs returned by the Model Harness.

status.description: Execution status of the model request.

provider_name.description: Active provider used (e.g. ollama, openrouter, gemini, anthropic).

model_name.description: Concrete model name that served the response.

content.description: Raw or parsed textual response content.

parsed_json.description: Structured JSON payload if parsed successfully.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls requested by the model.

cost_usd.description: Calculated financial cost (0.0 for local/free tiers).

validation_errors.description: List of validation errors if status is VALIDATION_FAILED.
